entries.dialogueText: Lucita discreetly glanced around as if making sure there was no one else with us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You're conveniently forgetting yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I hope you've narrowed it down from there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "My mother? How dare you insinuate such an awful thing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't have asked me to investigate if you thought I was guilty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Tell me what you’ve learned -- no matter how hard it is to hear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright, let's go down the list.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright, let's go down the list."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you're armed with substanti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're armed with substantial evidence."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As a matter of fact, I have.""
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I have."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I meant no offense. You instructed..."
entries.dialogueText: "I meant no offense. You instructed me to investigate everyone present at the palace during that time."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With whom should I begin?""
entries.dialogueText: "With whom should I begin?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me about my uncle. Why him?""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me about my uncle. Why him?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is all too vague. I want cold..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is all too vague. I want cold, hard facts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I seriously find it hard to believ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I seriously find it hard to believe that my uncle would murder his brother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If your account is accurate, we ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your account is accurate, we need to find out more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad you did. If what you're s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you did. If what you're saying is true, we must handle this delicately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, but what you're implying so..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, but what you're implying sounds too far-fetched."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me all the details about my m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me all the details about my mother's whereabouts on the night my father passed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's hear why you suspect Titus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hear why you suspect Titus."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, our investigative ef..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, our investigative efforts have unveiled a rather unexpected revelation."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Queen Mother was at dinner tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen Mother was at dinner that night. Later, as verified by Titus Gordion, she opened the door to your father's chambers and immediately alerted the Golden Guard that he was unconscious."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's good right?""
entries.dialogueText: "That's good right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dastnurist? Are you sure?""
entries.dialogueText: "Dastnurist? Are you sure?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If this is your idea of a joke, I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this is your idea of a joke, I'm not laughing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, they must have been mistaken.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, they must have been mistaken."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your guardsman's behavior was susp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your guardsman's behavior was suspicious, to say the least."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I find this accusation hard to bel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I find this accusation hard to believe. Titus has been nothing but loyal from day one."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""On the night of King Valero's deat..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the night of King Valero's death, Captain Gordion was charged with guarding his chambers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He probably just went to the toile..."
entries.dialogueText: "He probably just went to the toilet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He wasn't at his post? That's not..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wasn't at his post? That's not like Titus at all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did he or anyone else enter my fat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did he or anyone else enter my father's room during that time?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Not in the palace? Then where the hell was she?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So my mother has her own share of..."
entries.dialogueText: "So my mother has her own share of secrets... guess that makes her human after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's often taken it upon himself t..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's often taken it upon himself to personally oversee the king's security."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay, I'm listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, I'm listening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. And?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. And?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This only confirms my suspicions t..."
entries.dialogueText: "This only confirms my suspicions that he can't be trusted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is troubling news indeed. I'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is troubling news indeed. I've always taken Titus to be a loyal protector."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There must be some mistake. As far..."
entries.dialogueText: "There must be some mistake. As far as I'm concerned he is the epitome of honor and loyalty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want to know why you suspect Pab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to know why you suspect Pabel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a quick look around before..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a quick look around before proceeding.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm merely presenting the facts, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm merely presenting the facts, Your Majesty. It's unusual for someone in Pabel's position to be absent for such a long period."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you know, it is my duty to expl..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, it is my duty to explore every possibility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just because he was unaccounted fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just because he was unaccounted for doesn't mean he had anything to do with my father's death."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unaccounted for? Please explain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Unaccounted for? Please explain."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""During the time leading up to Vale..."
entries.dialogueText: "During the time leading up to Valero's death, there was a significant period when he couldn't be accounted for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure there's a reasonable expl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure there's a reasonable explanation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That sounds very un-Pabel.""
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds very un-Pabel."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He has access to the inner working..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has access to the inner workings of the palace, which made him a person of interest -- a detail that couldn't be overlooked."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She paused."
entries.dialogueText: She paused.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused."
entries.dialogueText: He paused.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Further investigation, however, re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Further investigation, however, revealed that Pabel had a solid alibi. His whereabouts during that time can be completely accounted for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What aren't you telling me?""
entries.dialogueText: "What aren't you telling me?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita gave a slight bow."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita gave a slight bow.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita bowed and bid me good day be..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita bowed and bid me good day before she turned and left my side.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that all? That doesn't prove he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that all? That doesn't prove he had a hand in anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were right to come to me, howe..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were right to come to me, however, we need something more concrete before jumping to conclusions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then I was correct in believing my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I was correct in believing my father's untimely end was no accident."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That quickly? Tell me more.""
entries.dialogueText: "That quickly? Tell me more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "An eyewitness? What led you to find that out?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If this information is inaccurate in any way, there will  be hell to pay."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "This is a lot to process. I'm having a hard time believing any of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "My God... A Dastnurist service? How can this be?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want to hear about what you foun..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to hear about what you found on the Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, multiple sources hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, multiple sources have confirmed to me that the Grand Wiseman visited the king's chambers the night of his death."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "In fact, at that time he was consulting privately with the King on a near-nightly basis."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Makes sense. He had plenty to aton..."
entries.dialogueText: "Makes sense. He had plenty to atone for."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What's interesting is that aside f..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's interesting is that aside from those meetings, witnesses describe your father's behavior as no more religious than usual."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He was even skipping services some..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was even skipping services some weeks."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, however, it's unusual for som..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, however, it's unusual for someone in Pabel's position to remain absent for an extended duration."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm sure. But for an individual in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure. But for an individual in Pabel's position to be away for such a prolonged period raised questions."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you know, to have someone of hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, to have someone of his status go missing for such an extended duration would raise suspicions."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Especially with Pabel's knowledge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially with Pabel's knowledge of the inner workings of the palace."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Could his absence be a coincidence..."
entries.dialogueText: "Could his absence be a coincidence? Sure. But it was something I couldn't overlook."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He has access to the palace's inte..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has access to the palace's internal operations, which made him a noteworthy figure in my inquiry."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""While it might be coincidental, it..."
entries.dialogueText: "While it might be coincidental, it was a detail we couldn't ignore."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He possesses knowledge of the pala..."
entries.dialogueText: "He possesses knowledge of the palace's internal workings, which rendered him a significant figure in my investigation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How wise of my father. I hope he f..."
entries.dialogueText: "How wise of my father. I hope he found the serenity he was seeking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father turned towards God... an..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father turned towards God... and away from everyone else."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's not surprising. God forgives..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not surprising. God forgives where humans don't."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure I believe that."

entries.dialogueText: "According to the Grand Wiseman himself, Valero turned towards God when he sensed that the end of his life was coming."

entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""According to the Grand Wiseman him..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Grand Wiseman himself, Valero turned toward God when he sensed that the end of his life was coming."

entries.dialogueText: "He wanted his enlightenment straight from the tap. I don't blame him."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you implying that the two of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you implying that the two of them were planning something?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Blasphemy! I myself have attended..."
entries.dialogueText: "Blasphemy! I myself have attended every single service since my coronation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That proves nothing. I myself skip..."
entries.dialogueText: "That proves nothing. I myself skip services all the time."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Grand Wiseman is one of the mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Grand Wiseman is one of the most respected figures in our kingdom. We should think twice before pointing the finger at him."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Maybe... but I believe this incons..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe... but I believe this inconsistency is worth looking into."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Especially since Grand Wiseman Ign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially since Grand Wiseman Ignacius was one of the last people to see your father alive."

entries.dialogueText: "I nonetheless believe this inconsistency is worth looking into."

entries.dialogueText: "Especially since Grand Wiseman Ignacius was one of the last people to see your father alive."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't know. But the inconsistenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. But the inconsistency sticks out to me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I haven't been able to establish a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't been able to establish a motive for the Grand Wiseman. But the means were there."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It strikes me as unlikely. But the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It strikes me as unlikely. But the inconsistency sticks out to me."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I haven't been able to establish a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't been able to establish a motive for the Grand Wiseman. But the means were there."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, your commitment to spirituali..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, your commitment to spirituality is a shining example for the rest of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm impressed. I could never sit t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm impressed. I could never sit through them myself."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Same here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Same here."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The Lord will forgive you. You're..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord will forgive you. You're a busy man."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am hesitant to cast blame on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am hesitant to cast blame on the Sanctuary. But I'd like to find out more about the nature of these meetings."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I do not want to soil the Grand Wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not want to soil the Grand Wiseman's good name. But I'm willing to dig further to find out the exact nature of these meetings."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita leaned forward, listening ea..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita leaned forward, listening eagerly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus stood at full attention, awai..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus stood at full attention, awaiting my next words.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Right. Dinner and a movie, then?""
entries.dialogueText: "Right. Dinner and a movie, then?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I can do better than that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can do better than that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "If our relationship was to continue..."
entries.dialogueText: If our relationship was to continue, I wanted to make sure she didn't have any skeletons in her closet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took no pleasure in suspecting my..."
entries.dialogueText: I took no pleasure in suspecting my own councilor, but it had to be done.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a note of uncertainty in..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a note of uncertainty in her voice.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a strangely somber tone t..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a strangely somber tone to his voice.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Perhaps you're better off not know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you're better off not knowing where your butler was that night."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you think I shouldn't know, I t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you think I shouldn't know, I trust you. Spare me the details."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In a manner of speaking...""
entries.dialogueText: "In a manner of speaking..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, forget it. I don't want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, forget it. I don't want to know. Case closed on Pabel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded forcefully."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded forcefully.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Case closed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Case closed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, let's move on.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, let's move on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded forcefully."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded forcefully.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Very well. Though this has absolut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Though this has absolutely no bearing on the murder case."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Saying that has only made me more..."
entries.dialogueText: "Saying that has only made me more curious."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head ruefully."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head ruefully.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right, now you definitely have..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right, now you definitely have to tell me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think I know what you're getting..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think I know what you're getting at. I've already given him a talking-to about it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded forcefully."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded forcefully.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If something similar happens again..."
entries.dialogueText: "If something similar happens again, I don't need or want to know about it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good interesting, or bad interesti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good interesting, or bad interesting?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He drew in a breath through clenche..."
entries.dialogueText: He drew in a breath through clenched teeth.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'll let you be the judge.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll let you be the judge."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it's not germane to the case, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's not germane to the case, I don't want to hear about it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Really, Your Majesty? This concern..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really, Your Majesty? This concerns your personal attendant..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But as you wish. Let's move on.""
entries.dialogueText: "But as you wish. Let's move on."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I am, however, obliged to tell you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am, however, obliged to tell you that in the course of charting out Mr. Adria's exact activities on that night, my team made a rather... interesting discovery."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Let's move on, shall we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's move on, shall we?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, gladly. I knew Pabel was inno..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, gladly. I knew Pabel was innocent all along."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She peered at me closely, trying to..."
entries.dialogueText: She peered at me closely, trying to gauge my reaction to the news.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He peered at me closely, trying to..."
entries.dialogueText: He peered at me closely, trying to gauge my reaction to the news.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My butler lies with men? He must r..."
entries.dialogueText: "My butler lies with men? He must repent his sodomous ways before it's too late!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But that's disgusting. I let him d..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that's disgusting. I let him dress me and everything."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It could be there's a perfectly in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It could be there's a perfectly innocuous reason they were down there, and the staff we talked to were spreading rumors out of boredom or spite."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But when I questioned the other Go..."
entries.dialogueText: "But when I questioned the other Golden Guardsmen, one of them admitted that Captain Gordion left his post that night."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The guardsman assumed Titus' dutie..."
entries.dialogueText: "The guardsman assumed Titus' duties for a half hour. The Captain could have gone anywhere during that time."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In between, however, Madam Estela..."
entries.dialogueText: "In between, however, Madam Estela was not in the Palace at all."

entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""In between, however, Madam Estela..."
entries.dialogueText: "In between, however, Madam Estela was not in the Palace at all."

entries.dialogueText: "Meh. Her behavior isn’t worth bringing to the Cantuavos’ attention."
